This page is the plain-language start for DOTE5891. Full definitions stay in the [Glossary](glossary.qmd); what you may cite as settled stays on [Official status](tracker.qmd).

## The idea in one breath

In Hong Kong, **low-altitude economy (LAE)** means economic activity in airspace generally below about **1,000 metres**. That is a **policy working description**, not a flying height written into Cap. 448G ([Glossary · altitude scale](glossary.qmd#altitude-scale); [Official status](tracker.qmd)).

Think of a **whole service**, not only a vehicle: aircraft, take-off and landing sites, traffic coordination, operators, customers, and supporting services such as finance and insurance. The course week map is on [Course overview](overview.qmd); Week 1 on [Lectures](lectures.qmd) opens the same idea.

Mainland **低空经济** uses a separate statistical / industrial-policy scope (NDRC 发改低空〔2025〕1676号). Do not treat it as the same metric as a Hong Kong value-added figure ([Glossary](glossary.qmd#mainland-comparators); [Official status](tracker.qmd)).

## Craft you will hear about

Everyday speech says “drone.” Hong Kong law’s main label for light unmanned craft is **small unmanned aircraft (SUA)** — unmanned aircraft not more than **150 kg** under [Cap. 448G](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law). “Drone” is not a Cap. 448G synonym ([Glossary · vehicles](glossary.qmd#vehicles-and-operations)).

**eVTOL** is an industry label for electric vertical take-off and landing craft. In Hong Kong, passenger-carrying or heavier types sit above the SUA ceiling and are treated as **unconventional aircraft** pending dedicated rules — there is **no dedicated Hong Kong eVTOL statute yet** ([Glossary](glossary.qmd#vehicles-and-operations); [Official status](tracker.qmd)).

**BVLOS** means flying beyond the remote pilot’s (or observer’s) visual line of sight. Different CAD circulars apply in different trial programmes — for example **AC-013** in the first Regulatory Sandbox and **AC-017** for Sandbox X cross-boundary flying ([Glossary](glossary.qmd#vehicles-and-operations); [Official status](tracker.qmd)). Weight ladders and permission diagrams live on the Glossary; this primer does not reprint them.

## Where craft take off, and how traffic is talked about

A **vertiport** is industry language for a take-off and landing site for advanced low-altitude craft. The 2025 Policy Address names planning of such sites; **Hong Kong has no dedicated vertiport statute yet**, and Action Plan text remains unpublished ([Glossary · infrastructure](glossary.qmd#infrastructure); [Official status](tracker.qmd)).

**U-space** is an EU / industry label for a set of UAS traffic services — **not Hong Kong law**. Do not write that Hong Kong “has U-space” ([Glossary · airspace](glossary.qmd#airspace-and-traffic)).

**UTM** (unmanned aircraft system traffic management) is industry usage. Hong Kong’s **Smart Low-altitude Traffic Management System** is **planned** — Policy Address language points to progressive implementation from **2028** — and is not yet a Hong Kong statute ([Glossary](glossary.qmd#airspace-and-traffic); [Official status](tracker.qmd); [Timeline](dates.qmd)). Sandbox X includes a UTM system-demonstrations module; live counts stay on Official status.

## Why this course centres Hong Kong and the GBA

The core setting is Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area, with EU / US / NASA-style comparators on [Course overview](overview.qmd) and [Readings](readings.qmd). Hong Kong already has an active policy track — Working Group, sandboxes, Cap. 448G and Advisory Circulars — traced on [Timeline](dates.qmd).

Two reminders you will need all term:

- **Regulatory Sandbox ≠ [Sandbox X](glossary.qmd#hong-kong-institutions-and-law).** Do not blend their project counts ([Official status](tracker.qmd)).
- The Shenzhen–Hong Kong / GBA **cross-boundary corridor is not operational** on the evidence tracked here ([Official status](tracker.qmd); [Timeline](dates.qmd)).

If a slide or article quotes **~HK$350 billion by 2050**, that is an **Our Hong Kong Foundation** projection, **not** a government figure ([Official status](tracker.qmd); [Glossary](glossary.qmd)).
